tldr: Mercury in Cancer: the mind is intuitive, protective, and shaped by memory.
body: With Mercury in Cancer, thought and feeling are intertwined. You communicate through emotional context, story, and the instinct to protect what matters.
gift: Emotional intelligence, memory, nurturing speech, and sensitivity to subtext.
challenge: Indirectness, defensiveness, and letting old feelings write the current sentence.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
